title: gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b
before: OpenAI had released no open weights since GPT-2 in 2019.
problem: The open ecosystem had consolidated around Meta and Chinese labs, with no US frontier lab participating.
breakthrough: Two open-weight reasoning models under Apache 2.0, trained with techniques from the o-series.
why: It reversed a six-year position and put a US frontier lab back in the open ecosystem.
next: Continued competition with Qwen, DeepSeek and Kimi at the open end.
inherits: Open weights as something every major lab now has a position on.
